title: F4: Spell-slot economy
description: Per-level slot counters on character live state seeded from the code-owned progression; expend(>= level) validation; long-rest restore hook (F7). Member: spell-slots (IMPL); clause: casting-a-spell-at-a-higher-level (slot-level legality gate; upcast scaling transform is F9). Source: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-execution-boundary-classification.md §4.
acceptance_criteria: ADR 0018 single-class guard is enforced before slot state is seeded, expended, or restored; ordinary Spellcasting slots come from the sole class progression; single-class Pact Magic remains a separate pool with its own slot level/recharge; no effective multiclass caster calculation, multiclass slot-table lookup, multi-class spell association, or Spellcasting/Pact Magic multiclass interaction is claimed; per-level counters, expend-at-or-above validation, and F7 long-rest restore hook are tested.
notes: D1 resolved by ADR 0018: F4 is deliberately single-class and depends on the shared fail-closed boundary bead.
close_reason: Implemented F4 spell-slot economy and addressed PR #433 re-review: applyLevelUp now reconciles derived slots atomically, with ordinary and Pact Magic context integration coverage.
